notes: Architecture remains adapter-independent and uses existing fake boundaries.
Participant scoping, consent checks, stale callback handling, and SQLite business-storage boundaries are covered by focused tests.
No new external SDKs, deploy artifacts, schedulers, PDF generators, or voice-processing dependencies were introduced.

findings.title: Current participant/week identifiers block unlimited insights in one week
findings.requirement: work/insight-flow/user-spec.md:169 states that multiple insights per week are allowed without limit.
findings.problem: start_add creates draft_id from only participant_id and week_number, while draft_sessions.draft_id is a primary key. After a successful save, the saved draft row remains for idempotency, so a second insight in the same week for the same participant attempts to insert the same draft_id and will fail with a SQLite uniqueness error. Final save also derives insight_id from only participant_id and week_number, so multiple saved insights in the same week would share one insight_id, making full-text callbacks ambiguous even if draft creation were fixed.
findings.impact: A participant cannot reliably add more than one insight in the current week, contradicting approved requirements and user decisions. Duplicate insight_id values also undermine list/full-text callback behavior for same-week insights.
findings.recommendation: Generate a unique per-draft identifier at draft creation, for example by appending a monotonic timestamp, UUID/ULID, or Telegram message id based nonce to the participant/week prefix. Derive insight_id from that stable draft_id or store a separate generated insight_id on the draft. Keep duplicate finalization idempotent by reusing the saved marker for the same draft, not by collapsing all participant/week insights into one id.
findings.suggested_regression_test: Add a service test that saves two insights for the same participant and week, asserts two distinct rows exist, both share the same week_number/current_week scope, and both have different participant-scoped insight_id values.

resolution.summary: Insight draft ids now include a unique UUID suffix and final insight ids are derived from the stored draft id, preserving idempotency per draft while allowing multiple same-week insights.

missing_tests: No regression currently saves two insights in the same participant/week, which allowed IA-001 to pass unnoticed.
